name: api_client
description: Make HTTP requests to REST APIs. Supports GET, POST, PUT, DELETE with JSON body and custom headers.

manual.overview: Use when you need to call external REST APIs or web services (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). Choose this over file-based tools when data lives on remote servers.

examples.description: Fetch a list of users from a REST API
Create a new order with JSON body

tips: Always set Content-Type to application/json when sending JSON bodies
Use appropriate HTTP methods: GET for reads, POST for creates, PUT for updates
Set reasonable timeouts for slow endpoints
Include Authorization headers when APIs require auth
edge_cases: Network failures may timeout; verify the URL and connectivity before retrying
Some APIs return non-JSON (HTML errors); check response parsing
Rate limits may apply; avoid hammering endpoints
